in-octopus-vulgaris.title: Octopus
in-octopus-vulgaris.summary: An intelligent, escape-prone predator that needs its own tank, lots of rock caves and a locked-down lid. Octopuses are short-lived: about 1–2 years.
rows: Varies; common octopus mantle up to about 10 in with arms to about 3 ft
55 gal or larger for small species; much larger for the common octopus
Carnivore: live feeder shrimp, mussels, crab meat and small fish; it also scavenges at night
notes: Anchor rockwork firmly so it cannot topple it.
warn: Escapes through tiny gaps: seal every opening in the lid.
Ink released in a tank can be deadly; do a large water change if it inks.
